WITH products_in_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    p.production_type_code,
    pc.product_type_description,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) as item_count,
    AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL)) as avg_qty
  FROM Products p
  JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code
  GROUP BY p.product_id
),
total_items AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total FROM Order_Items
),
product_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    production_type_code,
    product_type_description,
    item_count,
    avg_qty,
    CAST(item_count AS DECIMAL) / (SELECT total FROM total_items) as share
  FROM products_in_orders
),
per_product_type_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    product_type_description,
    AVG(avg_qty) as avg_qty_per_type,
    AVG(item_count) as avg_item_count_per_type,
    AVG(share) as avg_share_per_type
  FROM product_shares
  GROUP BY product_type_description
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_qty_per_type) as overall_avg_qty,
  AVG(avg_item_count_per_type) as overall_avg_item_count,
  AVG(avg_share_per_type) as overall_avg_share
FROM per_product_type_avg
